title: Aim projects the pointer through the camera's view, not its matrix (supersedes REC-2 constraint 1)
intent: Keep the aim steady while the screen shakes

attempts.failureReason: it goes through the render matrix, so camera shake jittered the aim

evidence.description: aim angle unchanged under shake and kick

constraints.statement: Project the pointer through cameras.main.worldView every frame, never getWorldPoint or pointer.worldX/Y; shake offsets the render matrix and must not move the aim
